name: LinkedIn
summary: Post as a LinkedIn member or Company Page, and handle comments and reactions.

triggers.name: New Company Page comment
triggers.description: Someone commented on a Company Page post (polled).

actions.name: Read LinkedIn profile
actions.description: Reads the connected member’s name and profile.

actions.name: List Company Pages
actions.description: Lists the Company Pages the member administers.

actions.name: Post as the member
actions.description: Publishes a post on the member’s own LinkedIn profile: text, images, a video or an article link.

params.name: articleUrl
params.description: Link to share as an article card

actions.name: Post as the Company Page
actions.description: Publishes a post on the Company Page: text, images, a video or an article link.

params.name: articleUrl
params.description: Link to share as an article card

actions.name: Delete a LinkedIn post
actions.description: Permanently deletes a post made by the member or Company Page.

actions.name: List Company Page posts
actions.description: Lists recent posts on the Company Page.

actions.name: Read post analytics
actions.description: Reads impressions, clicks, reactions and shares for Company Page posts.

actions.name: Read follower stats
actions.description: Reads Company Page follower counts and demographics.

actions.name: List comments
actions.description: Lists comments on a Company Page post.

actions.name: Comment on a post
actions.description: Comments on a LinkedIn post as the member or Company Page.

actions.name: Reply to a comment
actions.description: Replies to a comment on a LinkedIn post.

actions.name: React to a post
actions.description: Adds a reaction (like, celebrate, support…) to a post.
